headline: GOLD, SILVER 'SET TO RESUME' HISTORIC RALLY AS CEASEFIRE TALKS LIFT MARKETS
snippet: Spot gold near $4,750/oz and silver up 3% to $79.62 as analysts say the precious metals rally can restart once geopolitical fog clears. Iran peace deal optimism is the key near-term catalyst; silver's 150%+ one-year gain underscores structural demand from solar and investors.

headline: BHP CFO: COPPER TOPS IRON ORE AS NO.1 EARNER FOR FIRST TIME — AI DEMAND PULLING IN NEW INVESTORS
snippet: At the Macquarie Australia Conference, BHP's CFO says international generalist investors are rotating into the mining giant specifically for copper as AI data centres and grid electrification drive demand. Copper now accounts for 51% of BHP's EBITDA; FY26 production guidance raised to 1.9–2.0 million tonnes.

headline: CANALASKA EXTENDS WEST McARTHUR URANIUM TO 1.3KM STRIKE, HITS 5.2M @ 3.10% eU3O8
snippet: CanAlaska Uranium's winter drill program at the West McArthur JV in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin extended mineralization to 1.3km strike length and intersected new high-grade unconformity uranium of 5.2 metres at 3.10% eU3O8 approximately 250 metres from the Pike Zone core.

headline: EAGLE NUCLEAR (NUCL) KICKS OFF BASELINE WORK AT AMERICA'S LARGEST URANIUM DEPOSIT BEFORE JULY DRILL
snippet: Eagle Nuclear Energy (NASDAQ: NUCL) has launched environmental and archaeological baseline studies at its 37.73M-lb Aurora uranium deposit on the Oregon-Nevada border. A 27,000-ft PFS drill program starts July 2026, with a Pre-Feasibility Study targeted for late 2027.

headline: STANDARD URANIUM FINALIZES DRILL TARGETS, DEPLOYS TWO RIGS TO ATHABASCA BASIN ON MAY 31
snippet: Standard Uranium (TSXV: STND) has locked in drill-ready targets across the Warrior, Bronco, and Thunderbird conductor corridors at Davidson River. Two simultaneous diamond rigs mobilize May 31, with Rocas geophysics delivering basement uranium targets in the Saskatchewan Athabasca Basin.

headline: TROILUS GOLD (TLG) DROPS 40,000M DRILL PLAN AT FROTET-EVANS GREENSTONE BELT, QUEBEC
snippet: Troilus Gold (TSX: TLG) outlines a 40,000-metre 2026 drill program at its gold-copper project in Quebec's Frotet-Evans greenstone belt — a district that previously produced more than 2Moz of gold. The campaign targets resource expansion and infill drilling to advance the project toward feasibility.

headline: CHINA VACUUMS UP 790+ TONNES OF SILVER IN EARLY 2026 — SOLAR AND INVESTMENT DEMAND BOTH SURGING
snippet: China has imported more than 790 tonnes of silver in early 2026, with March alone hitting a record approximately 836 tonnes as solar panel manufacturers and retail investors compete for supply. The data reinforces the structural bull case for silver even as the metal consolidates near $79/oz.

headline: MINING M&A SURGES TO $21.6B IN Q1 2026 — STRONGEST START SINCE 2023, DEALS UP 34% YoY
snippet: Global mining deal value jumped 34% year-over-year to $21.6 billion across 121 transactions in Q1 2026 as gold sector consolidation and the race to lock in critical mineral supply chains drive activity. Strategic partnerships now account for nearly a third of all deal structures.

headline: GOLD MINERS STILL TRADE AT DISCOUNT TO THE METAL — ANALYSTS SAY THE CATCH-UP IS OVERDUE
snippet: Senior gold producers trade at just 9.6x forward cash flow despite gold above $4,700/oz and record free cash flow generation. Analysts argue the persistent valuation lag reflects investor scepticism about price sustainability — not fundamentals — and a sharp re-rating may already be underway.

headline: CHILE LITHIUM EXPORTS EXPLODE 175% IN APRIL AS SQM-CODELCO PARTNERSHIP HITS STRIDE
snippet: Chile posted $498 million in lithium carbonate exports in April 2026, up 175% year-over-year, as Q1 production volumes from the SQM-Codelco partnership rose 25%. Copper exports grew just 0.3% despite record prices, exposing throughput and grade headwinds at the country's aging porphyry mines.
